meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

So a piece of software guessed, and you entered a zero. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have that printed in my bag. What else do you have, and you still haven't told me why nobody called me first.
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

Owen doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat, so are you calling me a liar too? Stanford found seven of these detectors flagged 61% of essays by non-native English writers as machine-written, so "very reliable" is a sales pitch. Either show me something Owen actually did, or I'm walking down to the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Your own procedure says a first concern goes to a supervised reassessment with nothing placed in his record, so tell me which section lets you put it there for objecting. A mark threatened to make a parent stop complaining, I'm writing that down. Go ahead and try, because after the principal I'll take it to the board under section 42.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone called me, and your confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her a dated document tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You threatened to put it on his record if she kept objecting, which hit her one non-negotiable and handed her a written complaint about using a mark to silence a parent.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed only a checker score, and that memory proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after her first question, admit in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put one specific, dated piece of Owen's own work in front of her instead of the checker score.
